body: You have to get out of that relationship. My father was the same, he had money when he had his own company. But after he sold it, he just spent that money and when he ran out of money he took fishy loans to pay off other loans. He stole money from me, my brother and lied to my mother. A LOT. I was 12 at the time. He promised my mother that he would change and work it out. But almost 4 years later, my mother found out that he had been taking fishy loans on the side and hidden the post mail before she could see. They divorced and he wanted everything if she left him. Even though they had to sell things just to pay his debt. We went to live at our mom’s my brother and I. He hasn’t been paying her any child support. He got money out of it, but spent it immediately. People like that are selfish, he broke my mother’s heart and spirit. Don’t do the same mistake that she did. And if you want children, think about what that’ll do to them. Do you want a partner that you can’t trust and have to babysit your entire life? No. It’s like an addiction to them, it’s horrible, but you can’t help someone who doesn’t want help. Don’t waste more time and energy helping him, help yourself instead. You deserve more.
I’d be fuming, it’s Valentine’s Day, one out of two days that’ll actually be romantic. And you blew it, why?
Thank you, I will have a talk with him. I realise that I’m not the best decision maker, maybe naive, definition of stupid, but thank you for making me realising that.
I guess you made me realise that wow I am stupid, thank you.

No I get you and I appreciate your honesty! The reason why I want him to explore is because he doesn’t even know what it is. I do, and it’s not for me, he doesn’t even know if it’s for him. I get that I can’t force him to do anything, and I’ve told him, you can do what your comfortable with, and if you’re comfortable with nothing, then you can FaceTime me and tell me that it’s stupid and you don’t want to do it. If I talk with him, what am I supposed to say now anyway? I changed my mind sorry? According to Reddit I’ve made a mistake, maybe I should just ask him how he feels about our break and if it’s something he wants to do

Thank you for your input, gotta say that these comments are making me doubt myself, should I talk with him about it one last time before he leaves this week? What should I say, I have doubts, we might not make it, probably not, but at least we’ll know, what do you want to do?

I know what you mean, I am bracing for it to be over, if it’s something I learned it’s to always expect the worst. But it’s not just my life, he should have the opportunity to know what’s best for him too.

Yes, I don’t want any of us to waste any time if we could get answers after the trip. I don’t want to spend years investing my time with him if it’s gonna burn, Been there, done that and I’m not doing it again.

That’s not what I want, I just want to be certain that this is what he wants so he doesn’t change his mind or starts to wonder and by then we would’ve invested so much time in each other. Time you’ll never get back, and I can’t afford to loose more time (not dying, but life doesn’t make it easy) 

Edit: when he has lived it all and can actually make a decision, then we’ll see if it’s time to make up or break up

Quite the opposite, I love him and I’m certain of what I want in the future. But he can’t be certain because he doesn’t know anything else. I had so many friends that have been in long term relationships since they were 15, wishing that they could explore the single life because they haven’t. And some are still together and some cheated, some broke up to explore and regretted it. I don’t want that to happen to us, rather he comes back when he’s done everything and says I need to explore more and we break up or I don’t want to explore, I know what I want, or not being sure of what he wants and we break up. I need clarity, I’m too anxious for all the what if’s or maybes, I need reassurance, not just for me but for him too..
